summary: This note summarizes the ninth season of the American version of The Office. The season mainly follows Jim and Pam Halpert, whose relationship is strained when Jim decides to start a sports marketing company in Philadelphia and Pam worries about moving. Andy Bernard leaves the office for a boating trip, quits to chase stardom, and becomes famous for a viral video, while Dwight Schrute is finally promoted to regional manager. The season ends with a documentary airing and a reunion a year later for Dwight and Angela's wedding and a final round of interviews.
one_line: Plot summary of the ninth season of the American version of The Office, covering the Halperts' move, Andy's viral fame, and Dwight's promotion.
key_facts: The ninth season largely focuses on the relationship between Jim (John Krasinski) and Pam Halpert (Jenna Fischer).
Jim decides to follow his dream and start a sports marketing company in Philadelphia.
After Jim's decision, Pam begins to worry about moving, and the couple's relationship experiences stress.
Andy Bernard (Ed Helms) abandons the office for a three-month boating trip.
Andy Bernard eventually quits his job to pursue his dream of becoming a star.
Andy Bernard soon becomes famous for a viral video.
Dwight Schrute (Rainn Wilson) is finally promoted to regional manager.
The documentary airs during the season.
A year later, the members of the office gather for Dwight and Angela's marriage.
The year-later gathering also includes a final round of interviews.
